reviewed: All eight actual production editor exterior composites
findings: Every orientation distinct and complete in cell; shared animated wheels cover openings
Early LHD twin-level dash fitted; live speed, battery-input kW, gear and charge bar clear
Shared wheel seated below active displays; no logos or copied OEM pixels
limitations: Battery-input power includes modeled losses and is not mechanical motor output
Original tire/steering textures are fictional replacements
Gameplay movement is not a real-world performance calibration
